description: Defines multiple test font resolver classes implementing IFontResolver, including NullFontResolver and various TestXFilesFontResolver versions, for handling font resolution in PDFsharp library.

classes.name: NullFontResolver
classes.description: A font resolver that returns null for all font resolution requests.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver1
classes.description: A test font resolver that only resolves the 'xfiles' font, does not call platform resolver.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver2
classes.description: A test font resolver that resolves 'xfiles' and falls back to platform resolver if not found.

classes.name: TestXFilesFontResolver3
classes.description: A test font resolver that resolves 'xfiles' and throws exception if not found.

methods.name: ResolveTypeface
methods.description: Resolves font typeface based on family name and style, with different behaviors in each resolver class.

methods.name: GetFont
methods.description: Retrieves font data byte array for given face name, specifically for 'xfiles'.
